content: I had to clean out the bottom two holes on the tool dock. The screws would not go in the holes because of powder coat or paint build up.

I had the same issue just pinch the frame  together so the screw catches the lower part of the frame.

I also had a bit of a challenge with the lower right screw also. I honestly used a Bessey clamp to give me a little leverage on the frame.
I have tension on the frame, the top right screw won't let me fasten it, the holes do not align. What gives?
